findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_coach" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "coach" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: coach_client_brief, coach_client_post, coach_client_reviewed · Private data: preview_workout_import, preview_program_import, coach_client_reviewed · Public sink: send_note_to_my_members, get_my_brain_code, set_my_coach_principles, correct_my_coach, coach_client_brief, coach_client_workout, coach_client_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: coach_client_brief, coach_client_post, coach_client_reviewed · Private data: preview_workout_import, preview_program_import, coach_client_reviewed · Public sink: send_note_to_my_members, get_my_brain_code, set_my_coach_principles, correct_my_coach, coach_client_brief, coach_client_workout, coach_client_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
